facts.fact: AI-generated embedded text in Siren Protocol character reference imagery is non-canonical.
Romance, attraction, sexual relationships, household structure, jealousy, and harem membership among the core cast remain Campaign Plan content unless separately authored later.

The Level-5 character builds, allied side, loadouts, and equipment values in the v0.1 playable profile are implementation defaults that a Campaign Plan may replace; they are not immutable setting canon.
Siren Protocol is a Campaign Setting, not a Campaign Plan, and it does not prescribe a default player character, mandatory party, romance, sexual content, harem, premise, or starting location.
Siren Protocol v0.1 does not add armed-drone attacks, tactical vehicle combat, replacement BURST or FULL AUTO connection rules, or standardized projected-barrier combat numbers.
The cast templates do not yet define complete starting HP, RES, AP and inventory. Starting balance and numerical progression are explicitly pending; do not infer them from tests or display mockups.
Trigger Discipline is authoritative for Ruleset mechanics; Siren Protocol may select, interpret, reskin, constrain, or explicitly extend them without silently redefining them.
The present year of the Siren Protocol setting is 2225.
